summary: Only crypto traded into Sunday's close, and bitcoin's rout eased slightly as its 30-day drop narrowed to 24.3% and RSI lifted off last week's teens to 20, though price stayed 15% below its 200-day average. Stocks, bonds and gold simply carried Friday's levels, still pinned in fear by a VIX near 36, a firm dollar near 104 and 10-year real yields above 2.8%.
tweet: Crypto was the only mover this weekend, bitcoin's selloff easing (30d -24.3%, RSI 20) while stocks, bonds and gold held Friday's fear-gripped, VIX-36 levels.
